Compute Reference Sample Based on Covariance Norms

Source: R/data_processing.R
computeReferenceSample.Rd

This function computes covariance matrices for each sample, then calculates pairwise Frobenius norms between them to identify reference samples. Returns the top, bottom, median, reference, and validation samples.

Usage

computeReferenceSample(data, markers, sampleCol = "sample_id", N = 2)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing sample information.

markers

Character vector of marker column names.

sampleCol

Character; name of the sample ID column.

N

Integer; number of top and bottom samples to return.

Value

A list containing the matrix of norms, average norms, and sample indices for top, bottom, median, reference, and validation samples.

Examples

# Load sample data
data(sample_cytof_data)
data(sample_markers)

# Find reference samples based on covariance structure
ref_samples <- computeReferenceSample(
  data = sample_cytof_data,
  markers = sample_markers,
  sampleCol = "sample_id",
  N = 2
)

print(ref_samples$refSampleInd)
print(ref_samples$topNSamples)
print(ref_samples$bottomNSamples)
